hooks.command: command -v workmux >/dev/null 2>&1 && workmux set-window-status working || true
command -v codex-monitor >/dev/null 2>&1 && CODEX_MONITOR_EVENT=PostToolUse codex-monitor hook || true
command -v workmux >/dev/null 2>&1 && workmux set-window-status done || true
command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 && test -f "$HOME/.config/agents/reme-memory-bridge.ts" && REME_HOOK_HOST=codex REME_HOOK_EVENT=Stop bun "$HOME/.config/agents/reme-memory-bridge.ts" || true
command -v codex-monitor >/dev/null 2>&1 && CODEX_MONITOR_EVENT=Stop codex-monitor hook || true
command -v codex-monitor >/dev/null 2>&1 && CODEX_MONITOR_EVENT=UserPromptSubmit codex-monitor hook || true
command -v workmux >/dev/null 2>&1 && workmux set-window-status working || true

command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 && test -f "$HOME/.config/agents/reme-memory-bridge.ts" && REME_HOOK_HOST=codex REME_HOOK_EVENT=UserPromptSubmit bun "$HOME/.config/agents/reme-memory-bridge.ts" || true
